subject: Probe kit onramp — MAP, assets & usage cadence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@zephyrusretail.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Probe kit onramp — MAP, assets & usage cadence

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our call, attached is a compact probe kit we usually hand over for pilot evaluations and a first-pass MAP that lays out milestones to close the pilot and convert to a committed Dedicated trial. High-level proposal below: 

- Assets included: small prompt pack (10 intent-based cases), 500 test-case CSV, lightweight SDK example. See attachment: redwood_probekit_v1.zip
- MAP milestones: kickoff (data transfer + environment onboarding), acceptance sprints (2 weeks), quality gate, procurement signoff and limited production cutover. Draft attached: MAP_Zephyrus_draft_v1.pdf
- Constraints we need from you: sandbox IP allowlist, confirmation of data retention window (we propose 30 days for ephemeral evaluation logs), and whether your team needs encrypted-at-rest-only exchange (we support either).

Proposed timeline:
1) Dataset & MAP share: Tue Apr 13 (we can transfer via the shared Drive link below)
2) Acceptance sprint 1: Apr 15–Apr 28
3) Final QA & procurement: May 4–May 10

Can you confirm: a) that the retention window of 30 days is acceptable, and b) who on your side will own the procurement/NDAs so we can route the asset agreement? If you prefer, we can stage only an ephemeral subset first (50 cases) while security review completes.

Attaching: redwood_probekit_v1.zip, MAP_Zephyrus_draft_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Li <emma@zephyrusretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@zephyrusretail.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Probe kit onramp — MAP, assets & usage cadence

Jordan —

Appreciate the concise plan. A few quick clarifications from the security/procurement side: 

1) Retention: 30 days is acceptable for the ephemeral evaluation logs, but our legal team requires an explicit deletion confirmation once the pilot closes. Will you provide a takedown certificate?
2) Allowed usage: The testcases will be used only for model evaluation and must not be incorporated into any external benchmark corpora. We will sign a limited-use clause to that effect.
3) Transfer method: prefer a signed asset agreement and then a link to an encrypted Drive folder (SAML access). Procurement copied here will look at the MAP and the asset agreement PDF.

Can your team also fill out the attached security questionnaire — we need details on logging, access controls, and key management before we enable the sandbox network allowlist. I attached our internal checklist (security_questionnaire_required.xlsx) in this reply.

If the takedown certificate and restricted-use clause are in place, procurement is ready to fast-track this. Target for our side: review by Apr 16.

Best,
Emma Li
Director, Data Science
Zephyrus Retail

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Probe kit onramp — MAP, assets & usage cadence

Emma / team —

Quick follow-up from ops/legal side. We can provide both the takedown certificate and the limited-use clause in the asset agreement. A few operational notes: 

- Security questionnaire: we've filled in the majority of your requested fields and attached security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx. Key points: logs are ephemeral (30-day retention), access via SAML + RBAC, and keys are customer-managed for Private deployments (we will use RW-KMS for Hosted).
- Transfer plan: once you ACK the MAP, we'll create a SAML-restricted Drive folder and push the redwood_probekit_v1.zip there. If you want staged delivery, we can hand over the 50-case subset first and the remainder after procurement signoff.
- Runner environment: we recommend running initial acceptance in our ephemeral sandbox with token limits and no external telemetry. If you need an on-prem staging image, we can schedule delivery in week two of the acceptance sprint.

Link to shared Drive folder and HubSpot deal record included: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/zephyrus/probekit-onramp and https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4902

Let me know if procurement needs any redlines on the MAP; Naomi (copied) will track acceptance gates and the final sign-off checklist.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@zephyrusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@zephyrusretail.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Probe kit onramp — MAP, assets & usage cadence

Emma / Procurement team —

Great — glad that the high-level items look good. Confirming the agreed changes and next steps: 

- Redwood will provide a takedown certificate within 48 hours of the pilot end date; clause added to the MAP and asset agreement (see attached: zephyrus_asset_agreement_signed.pdf).
- Usage constraint: Zephyrus will have exclusive evaluation-only rights to these cases and will not republish them; we will append a limited-use addendum.
- Security questionnaire: Ben attached the completed workbook and we've added our KMS notes.
- Transfer: We will provision a SAML-restricted Drive folder tonight and push the full probe kit on Apr 14 at 02:00 UTC. If you want the staged 50-case subset earlier, we can push that tomorrow morning.
- MAP timeline (final):
   • Apr 14: dataset push (full kit) / access enable
   • Apr 15–28: acceptance sprints 1 & 2 (feedback checkpoints on Apr 20 and Apr 26)
   • May 4–10: QA & procurement sign-off

If procurement confirms review by Apr 16, we will begin onboarding immediately after. Naomi will run the acceptance gate calls and will schedule the first checkpoint this week.

Attachments: zephyrus_asset_agreement_signed.pdf, security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting the probe running.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
